research.brief: GTA 6 gameplay livestream by CarryisLive, commentary in Hindi/Hinglish with friends (Swizy, Scout). Want gameplay highlights (gunfights, stunts, chases, wild NPC moments) and the funniest reactions.

clips.label: GTA 6 Refused the Kiss
clips.title: Carry begs GTA 6 to show the kiss... it doesn't
clips.caption: More excited than the characters themselves 😭 L or W from Rockstar?

hint.hook: GTA 6 REFUSED TO SHOW THE KISS
hint.why: loudest stretch of the stream (LOUD +10..+13dB), 'dikhao! no! nahi dikhaya... thoda to chummi dikha de bhai... L GTA'; comments 'reason rockstar took 13 years' (66 likes), 'more excited than the characters', 'meme material'

clips.label: Street Fight Slap Fest
clips.title: GTA 6 street fight turns into a slap fest
clips.caption: Thappad after thappad 😂 Who wins this fight?

hint.why: running commentary on an on-screen fight: 'ye pitega... thappad maar diya... phir se... ye to gurjar hai' (comment 'Gurjar😂', 4 likes); fight should be visible

clips.label: Caught in the First Minutes
clips.title: Caught in the very first minutes of GTA 6
clips.caption: The bait didn't last long 😭 How fast did you get caught?

hint.why: 'are are are' LOUD +5dB then 'meri baiting khatam, main pakda gaya, starting mein hi pakda gaya'; must check on the verify sheet that the catch is visible

clips.label: First Seconds of GTA 6
clips.title: Carry's reaction to the very first seconds of GTA 6
clips.caption: Countdown, then pure screaming 😭 Were you this hyped too?

hint.why: countdown 6-5-4-3-2-1 then screaming as the game starts, LOUD +6/+7dB, comment '04:08 to 05:08' (9 likes)

clips.label: 13 Years Waiting
clips.title: Carry gets emotional: 13 years waiting for GTA 6
clips.caption: He was 13 when GTA 5 came out 🥲 How old were you?

hint.why: self-contained nostalgic monologue: 'GTA5 came out 13 years ago, I was 13, now I'm 27, some of us are married with kids'

clips.label: Dating App Neighbour
clips.title: Swiping on GTA 6's dating app and finding his neighbour
clips.caption: Wait, that's literally his padosan 😂 Would you swipe right?

hint.hook: GTA 6 DATING APP FOUND HIS NEIGHBOUR
hint.why: in-game dating app swipes on screen ('disalaik', profiles read out), punchline 'ye to hamari padosan hai bhai' twice, LOUD +4dB; visual check: the app UI should be on screen
